stars.center: State ex rel. County of Jackson v. Mo. Pub. Serv. Comm’n
edges: The court rejected County’s request to decide the merits in a natural gas rate matter despite the mootness of the case.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The court held that a civil contempt defendant has a right to a jury trial when the act of contempt was not committed in the presence of the court.
The judgment of civil contempt against the homes association was rendered moot when the association complied with the underlying order.
